Selected work

Four pieces to start with

Her most read article, her KevinMD guide, a long-form interview and the therapy workbook.

WORK 01ENDOMETRIOSIS FOUNDATION OF AMERICA

The Connection between Pelvic Pain & Childhood Trauma: A Medical Student Tells Her Story

Her own story, published in The Blossum by the Endometriosis Foundation of America. A Spanish edition was published alongside it.

Read the article WORK 02KEVINMD

Requesting disabilities accommodations in medical school

Her walkthrough of asking for accommodations in medical school, published on KevinMD and later recorded as a podcast episode.

Read on KevinMD WORK 03PODCAST INTERVIEW

Recognizing the Advocate Within Featuring Stephanie Moss

Her interview on A Bit From Within with Felicia Marti. Also available on Apple Podcasts.

Watch on YouTube WORK 04BOOKS

Individual & Group Therapy Workbook

A practical workbook for the mental health and personal growth of young adults, whether in individual therapy, group sessions or self-guided exploration. Drawing on multiple evidence-based modalities, it offers activities, prompts and exercises that encourage self-reflection, emotional regulation and connection. A companion Group Therapy Workbook was built to run groups with navy recruits on the FHCC in-patient unit.

Find it on Amazon

Events organized

Logistics at community scale

CHHRGE Volunteer CoordinatorA Safe Haven isolation flyer campaignAs CHHRGE volunteer coordinator she organized the calling and distribution of 75,000 isolation flyers to every Chicago COVID-19 testing center, for distribution to patients being tested. The flyer covered the A Safe Haven isolation center, open to homeless and doubled up individuals. She coordinated with the mobile and on site testing lab coordinators across Chicago.
Rush Medical CollegeRush New Student Fall Day of ServiceOrganized and led the day, where students distributed 40,000 pieces of PPE, 30,000 isolation flyers and 500 care packages. Led team-building leadership activities, including the creation of 500 more care packages.
Medical Coordinator, 2014 to 2018Colorado 9Health FairsPlanned, organized and led the medical screening portion of the yearly fair.
Fairview High School, Spring 2018 & 2019"We are Fairview"Over 100 mini TedTalk style presentations for all 2000 students to attend.
